name: Beat Stage
summary: Beat Stage - Battle Duel is a popular mobile rhythm game heavily inspired by Friday Night Funkin'. Players compete in high-stakes musical rap battles, tapping arrows or notes in time with the music to out-sing opponents. Features include battle and duel game modes where you compete against other players online. Modernized, Ultra HD redesigns of popular characters. And a variety of electronic, pop, rock, and mod-style tracks spanning multiple difficulties.
